q: AI coding 面试进入执行阶段后，面试官最常评估的不是你打字多快，而是什么？
options: 你是否持续提示、审阅并掌控 AI 的输出
你是否让 AI 独自决定架构方案
你是否尽量避免运行和验证代码
你是否写出全场最长的一段提示
options_en: Whether you keep prompting, reviewing, and steering the AI's output.
Whether you let the AI decide the architecture entirely on its own.
Whether you avoid running and verifying the code.
Whether you write the single longest prompt in the room.
why: 执行阶段考核的是你能否按计划驱动 AI、审阅它的产出并持续掌控方向，而不是把决策权交给模型。
why_en: During execution, interviewers watch whether you keep driving, reviewing, and steering the AI instead of handing it the decisions.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Plan[Plan] --> Prompt[Prompt AI]
  Prompt --> Review[Review output]
  Review --> Run[Run code]
  Run --> Adjust[Adjust]
  Adjust --> Prompt
optionMeanings: 持续提示、审阅、掌控的驾驶循环。
把架构决策整体让给 AI 的做法。
跳过运行验证、直接往下写的做法。
用提示长度而非内容质量取胜的做法。
optionScenarioImpacts: 方向始终由你把关，AI 只负责实现细节。
面试官看不到你的判断，只看到 AI 的判断。
错误会在多步之后才暴露，难以定位。
提示变长不等于约束更清楚，反而更难读。
optionDirectness: 命中评分点：驱动+审阅+掌控就是执行阶段的核心。
方向错：决策权旁落，面试官学不到你的判断。
步骤缺：跳过验证不是省时间，是风险来源。
粒度错：长度不是评分维度，内容精确度才是。
optionMeanings_en: The loop of prompting, reviewing, and steering.
Handing the whole architecture decision to the AI.
Skipping run-time verification and pushing ahead anyway.
Winning on prompt length instead of prompt quality.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Direction stays under your control while the AI handles implementation.
The interviewer sees the AI’s judgment, not yours.
Errors surface many steps later and are harder to trace.
A longer prompt does not mean clearer constraints — it gets harder to read.
optionDirectness_en: Hits the mark: driving, reviewing, and steering is the core of execution.
Wrong direction: control shifts away, so the interviewer learns nothing about you.
Missing step: skipping verification is a risk source, not a time saver.
Wrong dimension: length is not the scoring axis, precision is.

q: 写 AI 提示时，粒度的“甜点区”具体是什么？
options: 只给原始题目，让 AI 自己决定所有方案
明确要做什么和怎么做，但让 AI 处理语法和惯用写法
逐行规定变量名和代码格式
完全不用 AI
options_en: Hand over the raw problem and let the AI pick the whole approach.
State the what and how clearly, but let the AI handle syntax and idioms.
Dictate variable names and formatting line by line.
Skip the AI entirely.
why: 太泛会让 AI 接管决策，太细又变成隔着 AI 手写代码；合适粒度是你定策略、AI 写实现。
why_en: The sweet spot is stating the what and how clearly while letting the AI handle syntax and idiomatic implementation.
tradeoff: 约束够用 vs 微管理成本 —— 提示太泛让 AI 接管决策，提示太细就变成隔着 AI 手写代码。
optionMeanings: 把方案决策权完全交给 AI 的提示风格。
只锁定方案和约束、放开语法细节的提示风格。
把每一行实现都规定死的提示风格。
完全跳过 AI 辅助的极端选项。
optionScenarioImpacts: AI 选的方案可能不是你能在面试里讲清楚的那个。
AI 产出贴合你的方案，同时省下逐行输入的时间。
打字提示的时间接近手打代码，等于隔着 AI 抄写。
放弃了 AI 能带来的速度优势，回到纯手写节奏。
optionDirectness: 粒度错：太粗，决策权跑到 AI 手里。
命中甜点区：约束到方案层，放开到语法层。
粒度错：太细，退化成打字代理。
范围错：不是粒度问题，是直接放弃工具。
optionMeanings_en: A prompt style that hands the whole decision to the AI.
A prompt style that fixes the approach but leaves syntax open.
A prompt style that dictates every line of implementation.
The extreme option of skipping AI assistance altogether.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The AI may pick an approach you cannot defend clearly in the interview.
The AI’s output fits your plan while saving line-by-line typing time.
Typing the prompt takes about as long as typing the code yourself.
You give up the speed advantage the AI could have offered.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong granularity: too broad, control shifts to the AI.
Hits the sweet spot: approach fixed, syntax left open.
Wrong granularity: too narrow, you become a typing proxy.
Wrong scope: this drops the tool instead of tuning granularity.

scenario: 你要实现前缀搜索，并已经决定使用 trie（前缀树），每个节点要保存字符和是否为单词结尾。
q: 哪条提示最符合推荐的提示粒度？
options: 不给任何设计信息，只说一句“写点代码把前缀搜索功能实现掉，随便怎么做”
trie 支持 insert 和 prefix search，节点存 character、children、isEndOfWord
先声明一个变量 a，再写好 for 循环，然后要求 AI 逐行照我口述的语句往下写
需求只是新增一个前缀搜索方法，却要求 AI 顺带把整个项目重写成更好的分层架构
options_en: Give zero design detail and just say 'write some code, any way you like, for prefix search.'
A trie supporting insert and prefix search, each node storing character, children, and isEndOfWord.
Declare a variable, write out a for loop, then have the AI code exactly what I dictate line by line.
Even though you only need one new method, ask the AI to rewrite the whole project into a better layered architecture.
why: 这条提示锁定了数据结构和节点字段，但把语法实现留给 AI，正好落在推荐的提示粒度上。
why_en: This prompt fixes the data structure and node fields while leaving syntax to the AI, landing right in the recommended granularity.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是改一行判断条件，自己直接写通常比提示 AI 更快。
tradeoff: 锁定方案与字段 vs 逐行口述实现 —— 提示到数据结构层就够，细到变量名就是隔着 AI 手写。
codeSample:
Implement a trie that supports insert(word) and searchByPrefix(prefix).
Each TrieNode stores: character, children map, isEndOfWord boolean.
Fit it into the existing Dictionary class; keep it concise.
optionDiagrams:
flowchart LR
  Task[Raw task] --> AI[AI decides]
  AI --> Drift[Drift risk]

flowchart LR
  You[Trie decision] --> AI[Implement methods]
  AI --> Fit[Code fits plan]

flowchart LR
  You[Line orders] --> AI[Typing proxy]
  AI --> Slow[Slow loop]

flowchart LR
  Scope[Small feature] --> Rewrite[Rewrite project]
  Rewrite --> Risk[Huge risk]
optionMeanings: 把整个方案思考都丢给 AI 决定的极简提示。
锁定数据结构和节点字段、放开语法细节的提示。
把每一行代码顺序都口述给 AI 的逐行提示。
需求只是加方法，却要求 AI 做架构级重写。
optionScenarioImpacts: AI 可能选哈希表而不是 trie，偏离你已定的方案。
AI 产出符合 trie 结构的代码，你不用逐行盯字段名。
打字时间接近手写，AI 沦为打字代理。
重写范围远超当前任务，验证成本失控。
optionDirectness: 粒度错：太粗，方案决策权跑到 AI 那边。
命中甜点区：数据结构定好，语法交给 AI。
粒度错：太细，逐行口述等于手写。
范围错：越权到架构重写，不是这题的任务。
optionMeanings_en: A minimal prompt that leaves the whole approach to the AI.
A prompt that fixes the data structure and node fields, leaving syntax open.
A prompt that dictates every line of code in order.
A prompt that asks for an architecture rewrite when only a method is needed.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The AI might pick a hash map instead of a trie, drifting from your plan.
The AI produces code that fits the trie shape without you tracking every field name.
Typing time approaches hand-writing time; the AI becomes a typing proxy.
The rewrite scope far exceeds the task, and verification cost spirals.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong granularity: too broad, decision power shifts to the AI.
Hits the sweet spot: data structure fixed, syntax left to the AI.
Wrong granularity: too narrow, dictating lines equals hand-writing.
Wrong scope: overreaches into an architecture rewrite outside the task.

termDefinitions.meaning: 前缀树，一种按字符逐层存储字符串前缀的数据结构，适合前缀搜索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A trie is a prefix tree that stores strings character by character to make prefix search fast.

termDefinitions.meaning: trie 里的单个节点，通常保存一个字符、子节点集合和是否为单词结尾的标记。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A TrieNode is a single node in a trie holding a character, its children, and an end-of-word flag.

termDefinitions.meaning: trie 节点上的布尔标记，标记从根到此节点的路径是否恰好是一个完整单词。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: isEndOfWord is a boolean flag on a trie node marking whether the path from the root to this node spells a complete word.

scenario: 你要让 AI 实现一个复杂状态机（用状态和转移规则描述行为的模型），转移规则多且容易出错。
q: 这类任务的提示应该偏向什么风格？
options: 只说“实现状态机”
明确状态、转移、约束和边界行为
让 AI 自己发明状态
不要告诉 AI 任何现有接口
options_en: Just say 'implement a state machine.'
Spell out the states, transitions, constraints, and edge behavior.
Let the AI invent its own states.
Withhold every existing interface from the AI.
why: 复杂逻辑需要更具体的方向，避免 AI 用看似合理但不符合题意的状态设计。
why_en: Tricky logic needs precise states, transitions, constraints, and edge behavior so the AI implements what you actually intend.
whenOtherWins: 如果是重复样板代码，如类似的 API handler，可以用更短的提示再仔细验证。
tradeoff: 具体约束换正确率 vs 省提示时间 —— 逻辑越容易出错，越要提前说清状态和转移。
optionMeanings: 只给任务名称、不给约束的极简提示。
把状态、转移条件、边界情况都写清楚的提示。
把状态设计权完全交给 AI 的提示。
故意隐藏现有接口信息的提示。
optionScenarioImpacts: AI 大概率漏掉边界转移，之后要来回纠错。
AI 实现的状态机和你设计的转移规则一致。
AI 发明的状态可能看似合理但不符合题意。
AI 写出的实现和现有代码接口对不上。
optionDirectness: 粒度错：太粗，留给 AI 太多状态设计空间。
命中甜点区：状态、转移、边界都在提示里锁定。
方向错：状态设计权本该留给你，不是 AI。
信息错：故意扣住接口信息只会增加返工。
optionMeanings_en: A minimal prompt that names the task but no constraints.
A prompt that spells out states, transition conditions, and edge cases.
A prompt that hands state design entirely to the AI.
A prompt that deliberately hides existing interface information.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The AI likely misses edge transitions, forcing repeated correction later.
The AI’s state machine matches the transition rules you designed.
The AI’s invented states may look plausible but miss the intent.
The AI’s implementation clashes with the existing interfaces.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong granularity: too broad, leaves too much state design to the AI.
Hits the sweet spot: states, transitions, and edges are all pinned down.
Wrong direction: state design belongs to you, not the AI.
Wrong information: withholding interfaces only creates rework.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用有限个状态和转移规则描述系统行为的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state machine models behavior as a fixed set of states with rules for transitioning between them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 应用程序编程接口，模块之间约定好的调用方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An API is an Application Programming Interface, the agreed-upon way one piece of code calls another.

scenario: 你需要生成五个几乎相同的 API endpoint handler（接收请求并返回响应的处理函数），项目里这种模式已经很标准。
q: 面对这批重复 handler，最合理的 AI 用法是什么？
options: 给短提示让 AI 生成样板，再验证是否遵守既有模式
逐行手写所有重复代码以证明能力
让 AI 重新设计整个 API 层
跳过验证，因为样板一定正确
options_en: Give a short prompt, let the AI generate the boilerplate, then verify it follows the existing pattern.
Hand-write every repetitive handler to prove you can code.
Ask the AI to redesign the entire API layer.
Skip verification because boilerplate is always correct.
why: AI 很适合处理可验证的重复体力活，你仍要检查它是否照着项目模式写。
why_en: AI is useful for repetitive boilerplate that is easy to verify, as long as you still review it against the local pattern.
whenOtherWins: 如果 handler 里包含关键鉴权或事务边界，提示要更精确，不能只靠模板感生成。
tradeoff: 省时间 vs 验证成本 —— 样板交给 AI 换取速度，但你仍要核对它是否照抄了项目既有模式。
codeSample:
Generate 5 endpoint handlers: GET /orders/{id}, POST /orders, ...
Follow the existing handler pattern in OrderController exactly.
Keep error handling and response shape identical to current handlers.
optionMeanings: 用短提示换取样板速度，再人工核对模式一致性的做法。
拒绝借助 AI、逐行手打重复代码的做法。
任务只是加 handler，却让 AI 顺带重设计 API 层的做法。
生成后不做任何检查、假设样板天然正确的做法。
optionScenarioImpacts: 五个 handler 很快写完，且能验证是否贴合项目风格。
花费时间远超 AI 方案，且没有额外正确性收益。
范围失控，可能引入和当前任务无关的破坏性改动。
样板里如果藏着鉴权疏漏，会被直接放过。
optionDirectness: 命中评分点：AI 处理体量，你负责验证。
粒度错：把体力活留给自己，浪费面试时间。
范围错：扩大到架构重设计，偏离当前任务。
步骤缺：跳过验证，样板也可能抄错字段。
optionMeanings_en: A short prompt trades speed for boilerplate, then you verify consistency by hand.
Refusing AI help and hand-typing every repetitive line.
Letting the AI redesign the API layer when only handlers were asked for.
Assuming boilerplate is inherently correct and skipping review.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Five handlers finish quickly, and you can verify they fit the project style.
This takes far longer than the AI path with no extra correctness benefit.
Scope spirals out of control into changes unrelated to the task.
An auth gap hidden in the boilerplate would slip straight through.
optionDirectness_en: Hits the mark: the AI handles volume, you own verification.
Wrong granularity: doing the grunt work yourself wastes interview time.
Wrong scope: expands into an architecture redesign outside the task.
Missing step: skipping verification means fields can still be copied wrong.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: An API is an Application Programming Interface, the agreed-upon way one piece of code calls another.

termDefinitions.meaning: 处理某个 API 路径请求、返回响应的函数。

termDefinitions.meaning: 项目里高度重复、模式固定的样板代码，比如相似的 API handler。

q: 补全控制 AI 输出长度的原因：
text: 面试里要让 AI 输出{{简洁}}，因为每一行额外代码都需要你{{审阅}}并可能被要求{{解释}}。
why: 冗长输出会增加理解、验证和辩护成本，常常比它节省的打字时间更贵。
why_en: Concise AI output matters because every extra line must be reviewed and potentially defended.

scenario: 完成代码取向（先读懂项目结构再动手）后，你知道项目已有 Dictionary 类和 TrieNode 结构，需要新增前缀搜索。
q: 哪条提示最可能产出贴合代码库的代码？
options: 不提任何类名，只笼统地说写一个自动补全功能就行
给 Dictionary 添加 searchByPrefix，复用现有 TrieNode，返回 List<String>
不管现有结构，生成一个全新的 AutocompleteService 类和新的节点结构
不管代码库现状是什么样子，随便挑一种最快能跑起来的写法就行
options_en: Name no existing class at all, just vaguely ask for an autocomplete feature.
Add searchByPrefix to Dictionary, reusing the existing TrieNode, returning List<String>.
Ignore the existing structure and generate a brand-new AutocompleteService class with its own nodes.
Ignore whatever the codebase already looks like and pick whatever gets something running fastest.
why: 使用真实类名、方法名和数据结构会把 AI 限定在现有架构内，也向面试官展示你读懂了代码。
why_en: Using actual class names, method signatures, and data structures keeps the AI aligned with the existing architecture.
whenOtherWins: 如果现有结构确实不支持需求，应先说明缺口，再设计最小扩展。
tradeoff: 贴合现有架构 vs 生成速度 —— 引用真实类名换来能直接拼进代码库的输出，但提示要多打几个词。
codeSample:
Add searchByPrefix(String prefix) to the Dictionary class.
Reuse the existing TrieNode structure; do not create a new node type.
Return List<String> of all words matching the prefix.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Names[Real class names] --> Bound[Bound AI to repo]
  Bound --> Reuse[Reuse structures]
  Reuse --> Fit[Local fit]
optionMeanings: 不带任何代码库词汇的通用功能描述。
点名真实类、真实结构、真实返回类型的提示。
要求 AI 平行新建一套结构，而不是复用现有的提示。
放弃与代码库对齐、只求先跑起来的提示。
optionScenarioImpacts: AI 可能生成一套全新结构，和 Dictionary/TrieNode 脱节。
方法直接挂在 Dictionary 上，复用 TrieNode，改动面最小。
多出一套平行结构，和已有 TrieNode 重复且难维护。
短期能跑，但很可能和现有类型、命名冲突。
optionDirectness: 信息错：缺代码库词汇，AI 只能猜结构。
命中评分点：真实类名把 AI 锁定在现有架构里。
状态错：新建平行结构而不是复用，违背取向结论。
标准错：图快不图合，后续要返工对齐。
optionMeanings_en: A generic feature description with no codebase vocabulary.
A prompt naming the real class, structure, and return type.
A prompt asking the AI to build a parallel structure instead of reusing.
A prompt that abandons codebase alignment for whatever runs fastest.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The AI may invent a whole new structure disconnected from Dictionary/TrieNode.
The method lands on Dictionary and reuses TrieNode, minimizing the change surface.
A duplicate parallel structure appears alongside the existing TrieNode.
It may run short-term but likely clashes with existing types and naming.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong information: without codebase vocabulary, the AI can only guess the structure.
Hits the mark: real class names anchor the AI to the existing architecture.
Wrong state: builds a parallel structure instead of reusing, against the orientation findings.
Wrong standard: optimizes for speed over fit, creating rework later.

why_en: Codebase-specific vocabulary improves fit and demonstrates understanding, but it does not remove the need to review.
optionMeanings: 点名真实接口名，减少 AI 重新发明一套接口的做法。
让词汇对齐架构，降低和现有代码风格冲突的做法。
把用词本身当作面试官判断取向完成度的信号。

命中：用词本身就是取向完成度的信号。

scenario: 你发现只需要改一个变量名或一行条件判断，自己 30 秒能完成。
q: 这类小改动，最好的选择是什么？
options: 直接自己改
让 AI 生成完整补丁
先让 AI 解释变量名历史
暂停等待面试官指示
options_en: Just make the change yourself.
Ask the AI to generate a full patch.
Ask the AI to first explain the variable's history.
Pause and wait for the interviewer to tell you what to do.
why: 小修小改提示 AI 往往更慢，也会显得你离开 AI 就无法写代码。
why_en: For a tiny change you can make in seconds, writing it yourself is faster and shows you are not dependent on AI.
whenOtherWins: 如果小改牵涉多个文件或不确定副作用，可以请 AI 辅助定位影响面。
tradeoff: 自己改的速度 vs 提示 AI 的往返成本 —— 30 秒能搞定的事，提示往返通常更慢还更显得依赖 AI。
optionMeanings: 跳过提示环节、自己动手改一个字符/一行条件的做法。
为一个变量名或一行判断专门写提示生成补丁的做法。
在改之前先让 AI 讲历史背景的迂回做法。
遇到小事就停下等指令的被动做法。
optionScenarioImpacts: 30 秒完成，也展示了你不依赖 AI 也能推进。
写提示、等生成、审阅补丁的总时间超过直接改。
多绕一步解释背景，进一步拖慢这个 30 秒级别的任务。
面试官会觉得你连一行判断都不敢自己动手。
optionDirectness: 命中评分点：小任务直接手做最快。
粒度错：为微小改动走完整提示流程。
步骤多余：历史背景不影响这一行改动。
信号差：暴露对 AI 的依赖，而非独立判断。
optionMeanings_en: Skipping the prompt loop and changing one character or condition yourself.
Writing a dedicated prompt to generate a patch for one variable rename.
Detouring to ask the AI for historical context before making the change.
Pausing on a tiny task to wait for instruction.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It finishes in 30 seconds and shows you don’t depend on the AI.
The total time of prompting, waiting, and reviewing exceeds just fixing it.
The extra context detour slows down what is a 30-second task.
The interviewer may read this as being unable to touch one line yourself.
optionDirectness_en: Hits the mark: small tasks are fastest done by hand.
Wrong granularity: running a full prompt loop for a tiny change.
Unnecessary step: history context doesn’t affect this one-line edit.
Bad signal: exposes AI dependency instead of independent judgment.

scenario: 某段标准数据结构实现你知道方案正确，但手写要五分钟，AI 十秒可生成且容易测试。
q: 这类工作更适合谁来做？
options: 让 AI 生成，你负责方向和验证
永远手写，避免使用 AI
让 AI 决定数据结构
跳过测试直接继续
options_en: Let the AI generate it while you own the direction and verification.
Always hand-write it and avoid AI entirely.
Let the AI decide which data structure to use.
Skip testing and move straight on.
why: AI 适合体量大、正确性可验证的实现工作；关键是方案仍由你选择。
why_en: Use AI for high-volume implementation that is easy to verify while keeping the design decision yourself.
whenOtherWins: 如果难点是算法选择或边界推理，应先自己想清楚再让 AI 实现。
tradeoff: 生成速度 vs 决策归属 —— AI 承担打字体量，但数据结构的选择仍必须是你的判断。
optionMeanings: AI 出实现、你出方案并核对正确性的分工做法。
无条件排斥 AI，即便是可验证体力活也手写的做法。
把该由你做的结构选择也甩给 AI 的做法。
生成之后不测试就继续往下写的做法。
optionScenarioImpacts: 十秒拿到实现，五分钟省下来做更难的部分。
白白花掉五分钟在一段已知正确的实现上。
如果 AI 选错结构，后续边界情况可能出错。
把潜在 bug 一路带进下一步开发。
optionDirectness: 命中评分点：AI 管体量，你管判断。
效率错：拒绝工具反而拖慢已验证的体力活。
方向错：结构选择本该是你的判断，不是 AI 的。
步骤缺：跳过验证，正确性无从确认。
optionMeanings_en: The AI implements while you choose the approach and check correctness.
Refusing AI unconditionally, even for verifiable grunt work.
Handing the structure choice — which should be yours — to the AI.
Moving on without testing what was just generated.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The implementation lands in ten seconds, freeing five minutes for harder work.
Five minutes are spent on an implementation you already knew was correct.
A wrong structure choice by the AI can break on later edge cases.
Any hidden bug carries straight into the next step of development.
optionDirectness_en: Hits the mark: the AI handles volume, you own judgment.
Wrong efficiency: refusing the tool slows down already-verified grunt work.
Wrong direction: structure choice should be yours, not the AI’s.
Missing step: skipping verification leaves correctness unconfirmed.

q: 补全 AI 使用原则：
text: 把 AI 用在{{体量}}上，把自己用在{{判断}}上；AI 可以写得快，但方案选择和取舍要由你负责。
why: 面试要评估你的工程判断，而不是你把模型输出转发到代码库的速度。
why_en: Use AI for volume and yourself for judgment, because the interview evaluates your engineering decisions.
tradeoff: AI 出体量 vs 你出判断 —— 生成速度换不来方案责任，选择和取舍必须你来担。

q: 为什么不要连续堆叠多次 AI 生成后才第一次运行代码？
options: AI 会拒绝继续生成
多个局部正确的改动可能互相冲突，最后形成级联错误
运行代码会降低面试评分
测试只能在最后运行
options_en: The AI will refuse to keep generating.
Several locally-correct changes can conflict and surface as one cascading failure.
Running code lowers your interview score.
Tests can only be run at the very end.
why: 每次有意义生成后运行能把错误隔离在最近一步，避免最后同时面对多处冲突。
why_en: Running after each meaningful generation isolates failures to the latest change instead of creating a cascade.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Gen1[Generate step 1] --> Gen2[Generate step 2]
  Gen2 --> Gen3[Generate step 3]
  Gen3 --> Fail[Mixed failure]
  Run[Run each step] -.-> Isolate[Small failure]
optionMeanings: 把工具行为想象成会主动拒绝的极端说法。
把多步生成的冲突后果说成级联错误的说法。
把运行代码和评分倒挂的错误说法。
把测试时机限制死在最后一步的说法。
optionScenarioImpacts: 不成立，AI 不会因为堆叠生成就拒绝工作。
越堆越多，最后一次运行时要同时定位多处冲突。
实际相反，面试官更认可频繁验证的习惯。
如果只在最后测，前面的错误早已互相掩盖。
optionDirectness: 事实错：不是 AI 拒绝，是错误会累积。
命中评分点：局部正确不等于整体正确，冲突在最后爆发。
方向反：运行验证是加分项，不是扣分项。
时机错：测试应贴着每步生成走，不是攒到最后。
optionMeanings_en: The extreme claim that the tool would actively refuse to continue.
Naming the conflict outcome of stacked generations as a cascade.
The inverted claim that running code lowers your score.
Fixing test timing to the very last step only.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Not true — the AI doesn’t refuse just because generations stack up.
The pile grows, and the final run must untangle several conflicts at once.
The opposite is true — interviewers favor frequent verification.
If testing only happens at the end, earlier errors are already masked.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong fact: it is not refusal, it is accumulated error.
Hits the mark: locally correct is not globally correct, and the conflict surfaces at the end.
Reversed direction: running code is a plus, not a minus.
Wrong timing: tests should track each generation, not pile up until the end.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个局部改动叠加后互相冲突，在最后一次运行时集中爆发的一串错误。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cascading errors happen when several stacked changes conflict and surface together the first time you finally run the code.

q: 把增量执行循环排成正确顺序：
steps: 让 AI 完成一个明确小步骤
确认通过后进入下一步
why: 核心原则是每个有意义变更后马上验证，有问题先修，不在破损代码上继续叠新功能。
why_en: The loop is: generate one clear step, run checks, fix any breakage, then move on.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Prompt[Prompt one change] --> Review[Review diff]
  Review --> Run[Run tests]
  Run --> Decide{Pass?}
  Decide -->|yes| Next[Next step]
  Decide -->|no| Fix[Fix latest step]
  Fix --> Run

q: AI 的“训练数据偏置”（更容易给出训练语料里最常见的解法）在面试中常表现为什么？
options: 给出教科书式解法，但不一定适合当前约束或代码库
永远拒绝回答算法题
只能生成注释不能生成代码
自动识别所有公司偏好
options_en: It gives a textbook solution that may not fit your specific constraints or codebase.
It always refuses to answer algorithm questions.
It can only generate comments, never code.
It automatically detects every company's preferences.
why: AI 可能给出技术上正确、策略上不合适的常见解法，你要判断它是否匹配题目约束和现有工具。
why_en: Training-data bias often gives a textbook solution that may not fit the specific constraints or codebase.
optionMeanings: 把训练语料里最常见解法直接搬过来的表现。
把偏置误解成完全拒答的极端说法。
把偏置误解成生成能力残缺的说法。
把偏置误解成一种万能感知能力的说法。
optionScenarioImpacts: 解法技术正确，但可能没用到代码库已有的更简方案。
不成立，训练偏置不等于拒绝作答。
不成立，偏置和生成代码的能力无关。
不成立，AI 不会自动知道具体公司偏好。
optionDirectness: 命中评分点：常见解法不等于贴合当前约束的解法。
定义错：偏置是内容倾向，不是拒答行为。
定义错：偏置和输出形式无关。
定义错：偏置不带来公司级别的感知能力。
optionMeanings_en: Reaching for the most common solution in the training corpus.
The extreme claim that bias means outright refusal.
The misconception that bias limits generation to comments only.
The misconception that bias grants company-specific awareness.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The solution is technically correct but may skip a simpler codebase-fit option.
Not true — training bias does not mean refusing to answer.
Not true — bias is unrelated to the ability to generate code.
Not true — the AI has no automatic awareness of company preferences.
optionDirectness_en: Hits the mark: common does not mean constraint-fitting.
Wrong definition: bias is a content tendency, not a refusal behavior.
Wrong definition: bias is unrelated to output form.
Wrong definition: bias grants no company-level awareness.

termDefinitions.meaning: AI 更容易给出训练语料里最常见的解法，而不一定是最贴合当前约束的解法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-data bias means the AI defaults to the most common solution in its training data, which may not fit your specific constraints.

q: AI 输出过度冗长的主要代价是什么？
options: 代码量越大就一定越正确
面试官看到长代码一定更喜欢
你需要理解、验证并解释更多不必要的抽象和注释
测试覆盖率会自动跟着变全面
options_en: More code always means more correctness.
The interviewer always likes seeing more code.
You have to understand, verify, and defend more unnecessary abstractions and comments.
Test coverage automatically becomes more thorough.
why: 冗长代码增加审查面，也给面试官更多可追问但你未必能防守的内容。
why_en: Verbose output expands the surface you must understand, verify, and defend.
optionMeanings: 把代码量和正确性画等号的误解。
把冗长和面试官偏好画等号的误解。
指出冗长直接放大审查和答辩面的代价。
把冗长和测试覆盖率画等号的误解。
optionScenarioImpacts: 不成立，行数和正确性没有必然关系。
不成立，面试官通常更欣赏精简可控的输出。
每多一行都要能讲清楚它为什么在那里。
不成立，冗长的实现代码不会自动生成测试。
optionDirectness: 方向错：混淆代码量与正确性。
方向反：冗长通常是减分信号，不是加分信号。
命中评分点：审查面和答辩面被动放大。
范围错：把实现冗长和测试质量混为一谈。
optionMeanings_en: The misconception that more code equals more correctness.
The misconception that the interviewer always prefers more output.
Naming how verbosity expands the surface you must review and defend.
The misconception that verbosity improves test coverage.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Not true — line count has no necessary link to correctness.
Not true — interviewers usually prefer concise, controlled output.
Every extra line needs a reason you can explain on the spot.
Not true — verbose implementation code does not auto-generate tests.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong direction: confuses code volume with correctness.
Reversed direction: verbosity is usually a minus, not a plus.
Hits the mark: the review and defense surface expands passively.
Wrong scope: conflates implementation verbosity with test quality.

q: 哪些是 AI 常见的设计捷径或过度设计？（多选）
options: 为两个几乎无关的类创建 BaseProcessor
不必要地引入深继承层级
把简单 if-else 包成 strategy pattern
遵守现有最小接口
options_en: Create a BaseProcessor superclass for two barely related classes.
Introduce unnecessarily deep inheritance hierarchies.
Wrap a simple if-else in a strategy pattern.
Stick to the existing minimal interface.
why: 这些抽象可能不直接破坏功能，但会显得你接受了没有必要的设计复杂度。
why_en: Unneeded base classes, deep inheritance, and strategy wrappers can signal that you accepted lazy over-engineering.
optionMeanings: 硬造一个几乎没有共性的公共父类。
在简单继承关系上叠出多层不必要的父类。
用设计模式包装一个原本三五行就够的分支。
不额外新增抽象，保持接口和现状一致。
optionScenarioImpacts: 以后改一个类容易牵连另一个不相关的类。
定位一个方法实际生效在哪一层变得更难。
读者要多理解一层模式结构才能看懂分支逻辑。
接口保持最小，读者不需要学习新增结构。
optionDirectness: 命中：典型过度抽象，共性不足以立父类。
命中：继承层级和实际需求不成比例。
命中：模式复杂度超过了分支本身的复杂度。
方向反：这是应当保留的克制做法，不是过度设计。
optionMeanings_en: Forcing a shared superclass onto two classes with almost nothing in common.
Stacking unnecessary extra layers onto a simple inheritance chain.
Wrapping a three-line branch in a design pattern.
Adding no extra abstraction and keeping the interface as-is.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Later changes to one class can accidentally ripple into the unrelated one.
Tracing which layer a method actually runs in becomes harder.
Readers must learn an extra pattern layer just to see the branch logic.
The interface stays minimal, so readers learn nothing new.
optionDirectness_en: Hits the mark: classic over-abstraction, too little in common to justify a superclass.
Hits the mark: the inheritance depth is disproportionate to the need.
Hits the mark: pattern complexity exceeds the branch it wraps.
Reversed direction: this restraint is the correct call, not over-design.

termDefinitions.meaning: 示例中 AI 为两个几乎无关的类硬造出的公共父类，是过度抽象的典型产物。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BaseProcessor is the example of an unnecessary shared superclass the AI invents for two barely related classes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种把可替换算法封装成独立类、通过接口切换的设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The strategy pattern wraps interchangeable algorithms in separate classes swapped through a common interface.

q: 哪些 AI 生成行为属于严重的 correctness shortcut（掩盖而非修复真实错误的取巧做法）？（多选）
options: 删除失败测试而不是修实现
用 any 绕过类型错误
吞掉异常或硬编码特定测试值
保留失败测试并定位根因
options_en: Delete a failing test instead of fixing the implementation.
Use `any` to bypass a type error.
Swallow exceptions or hardcode specific test values.
Keep the failing test and track down the root cause.
why: 这些做法让表面错误消失，但真实问题仍在，是面试官会追问的红旗。
why_en: Deleting tests, silencing types, or hardcoding values hides bugs instead of fixing them.
optionMeanings: 把失败测试直接删掉，让红灯变绿灯的做法。
用 any 类型压住编译期报错的做法。
catch 块什么也不做，或者把返回值写死成测试期望值的做法。
测试红了先不改，先去追查为什么红的做法。
optionScenarioImpacts: 底层 bug 依然存在，只是不再被测试发现。
类型系统失去保护，运行时才可能炸出错误。
错误被隐藏，且换一组输入立刻打回原形。
能找到真实 bug 根因，是应保留的正确做法。
optionDirectness: 命中：表面通过，问题原样保留。
命中：类型检查形同虚设，红旗行为。
命中：错误被压制而非修复，红旗行为。
方向反：这是正确应对失败测试的方式，不是 shortcut。
optionMeanings_en: Deleting a failing test so the red light turns green.
Using `any` to suppress a compile-time type error.
An empty catch block, or hardcoding a return value to match the test.
Leaving the test red and tracing why it fails.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The underlying bug still exists; it just stops showing up in tests.
The type system loses its protection until it breaks at runtime.
The error is hidden and resurfaces the moment inputs change.
This finds the real root cause and is the correct thing to keep doing.
optionDirectness_en: Hits the mark: passes on the surface, the problem stays underneath.
Hits the mark: type checking becomes meaningless, a red flag.
Hits the mark: the error is suppressed rather than fixed, a red flag.
Reversed direction: this is the correct response to a failing test, not a shortcut.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为了让代码看起来通过，掩盖而非修复真实错误的取巧做法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A correctness shortcut is a trick that makes code look like it passes without actually fixing the underlying bug.

termDefinitions.meaning: TypeScript 中关闭类型检查的“万能类型”，用它能绕过编译期类型错误。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In TypeScript, `any` is the escape-hatch type that turns off compile-time type checking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 捕获异常的语法结构，如果 catch 块什么也不做就会把错误悄悄吞掉。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把本该动态计算的值写死成固定值，通常只为让某个测试用例通过。

scenario: AI 第一次输出偏离你的要求，没有使用你指定的数据结构。
q: 这时最好的下一步是什么？
options: 原样重复同一个提示
接受偏离，继续叠功能
带更多上下文重新表述，明确必须使用的数据结构
马上切换模型，完全不改提示
options_en: Repeat the exact same prompt again.
Accept the drift and keep layering new features.
Rephrase with more context, stating the required data structure explicitly.
Immediately switch models without changing the prompt at all.
why: 如果第一次没理解，重复原话通常不会改善；更清晰的上下文和约束才是有效修正。
why_en: If the AI missed the request, rephrase with clearer context and constraints rather than repeating the same prompt.
whenOtherWins: 如果偏离只是一个小局部且你能十秒改好，直接手修会更快。
tradeoff: 重提示一次的时间成本 vs 偏差累积的返工成本 —— 说清楚约束换取一次修正，好过在错误结构上继续堆功能。
codeSample:
Before: "Implement the cache eviction logic."
After: "Implement cache eviction using a doubly linked list + hash map
for O(1) LRU eviction, matching the existing Cache class fields."
optionMeanings: 不加任何新信息、直接复述原话的做法。
明知偏离，仍继续在错误结构上叠功能的做法。
补上数据结构约束和背景后重新表述的做法。
把问题归咎于模型、跳过提示改进的做法。
optionScenarioImpacts: AI 第一次没理解，原样重复大概率还是同一个结果。
后续功能建在错误结构上，返工成本随时间放大。
AI 拿到明确的数据结构要求，输出更可能对齐。
换模型有上下文切换成本，且没解决约束不清的根因。
optionDirectness: 步骤空转：没有新信息，不太可能改变结果。
时机错：在已知偏差上继续推进，代价会累积。
命中评分点：补足约束，直接对因下药。
方向错：切换成本高，且没先尝试更便宜的重提示。
optionMeanings_en: Repeating the exact wording with no new information.
Continuing to build on a structure known to be wrong.
Rephrasing with the missing data-structure constraint and context.
Blaming the model and skipping any prompt improvement.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The AI missed it once; repeating verbatim likely gives the same result.
Later features build on the wrong structure, and rework cost grows over time.
With an explicit data-structure requirement, output is more likely to align.
Switching costs context-rebuild time and doesn’t fix the unclear constraint.
optionDirectness_en: Spinning wheels: no new information, unlikely to change the outcome.
Wrong timing: pressing on with a known deviation compounds the cost.
Hits the mark: fills the missing constraint, addresses the actual cause.
Wrong direction: switching is costly and skips the cheaper reprompt first.

q: 开放式面试里为什么建议频繁提交或保留回滚点（代码可运行时的一次提交）？
options: 为了在面试官面前展示自己熟悉多少条 git 命令
因为面试系统里每提交一次代码都会自动加一次分
AI 连续跑偏时，回到上一个可运行状态通常比手工拆坏改动更快
为了图省事，正好可以借口避免再写测试
options_en: To show the interviewer how many git commands you know.
Because the interview system auto-adds points for every single commit.
When the AI drifts repeatedly, returning to the last working state is usually faster than manually undoing the damage.
As a convenient excuse to avoid writing tests.
why: 坏生成叠多了会很难局部修复，干净回滚点能保护你不被错误改动拖住。
why_en: Frequent checkpoints let you return to a working state when several bad AI generations pile up.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Good[Known good] --> Commit[Checkpoint]
  Commit --> Try[AI change]
  Try --> Bad{Bad path?}
  Bad -->|yes| Back[Rollback]
  Bad -->|no| Keep[Keep going]
optionMeanings: 把回滚点的价值误解成炫技的说法。
把提交次数和评分直接挂钩的误解。
把回滚点的价值定位在快速恢复可运行状态。
把回滚点当成逃避测试的借口的误解。
optionScenarioImpacts: 不成立，命令数量不是面试评分点。
不成立，提交频率本身不构成加分项。
省下手工排查多处叠加改动的时间。
不成立，回滚点和是否写测试是两件事。
optionDirectness: 方向错：目的不是展示，是恢复速度。
机制错：分数不来自提交次数本身。
命中评分点：坏生成叠多了，回滚比手拆更快。
范围错：回滚点不替代测试这一步。
optionMeanings_en: The misconception that rollback points are for showing off.
The misconception that commit count directly raises your score.
Placing the value of rollback points in fast recovery to a working state.
The misconception that rollback points are an excuse to skip tests.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Not true — command count is not a scoring dimension.
Not true — commit frequency alone is not a bonus.
It saves the time of manually tracing several stacked changes.
Not true — rollback points and writing tests are separate concerns.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong direction: the goal is recovery speed, not display.
Wrong mechanism: score does not come from commit count itself.
Hits the mark: once bad generations pile up, rollback beats manual undo.
Wrong scope: rollback points don’t replace the testing step.

termDefinitions.meaning: 代码处于已知可运行状态时的一次提交，可以随时退回。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rollback point is a commit made while the code is in a known-working state that you can return to.

q: AI 输出“90% 正确”时，为什么手工逐行补最后 10% 常常是陷阱？
options: 因为手写代码永远不允许
因为 AI 会删除你的改动
你可能花更久修补混乱结构，不如用更清楚的提示重新生成
因为 90% 正确一定已经够用
options_en: Because hand-writing code is never allowed.
Because the AI will delete your edits.
You may spend longer patching a confused structure than reprompting clearly for a clean regeneration.
Because 90% correct is always good enough already.
why: 半 AI 半手补的代码容易变乱，如果偏差来自误解需求，清晰重提示通常更快。
why_en: Patching a mostly-wrong output can be slower than reprompting clearly because the structure may already be misaligned.
optionMeanings: 把手写代码想象成被禁止的极端说法。
把陷阱归因于 AI 会主动破坏你的改动。
指出手工打补丁的隐藏时间成本高于重提示。
把 90% 正确直接当作已经达标的误解。
optionScenarioImpacts: 不成立，手写从来不是被禁止的选项。
不成立，AI 不会主动删除你后加的改动。
半 AI 半手改的代码结构容易更乱，越补越慢。
剩下的 10% 往往正是边界情况，不能默认够用。
optionDirectness: 方向错：陷阱不是禁令问题。
机制错：风险不来自 AI 删除行为。
命中评分点：结构已偏，修补成本可能超过重来。
标准错：90% 不等于达标，取决于缺的那 10% 是什么。
optionMeanings_en: The extreme claim that hand-writing is never allowed.
Blaming the trap on the AI actively deleting your edits.
Pointing out the hidden time cost of manual patching versus reprompting.
Treating 90% correct as automatically good enough.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Not true — hand-writing is never off-limits.
Not true — the AI doesn’t actively delete edits you add afterward.
Half-AI, half-hand-edited code tends to get messier the more you patch it.
The missing 10% is often exactly the edge case that can’t be assumed fine.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong direction: the trap is not about a ban.
Wrong mechanism: the risk doesn’t come from the AI deleting anything.
Hits the mark: the structure is already skewed, patching may cost more than redoing.
Wrong standard: 90% is not automatically good enough — it depends what the missing 10% is.

scenario: 你已经花两分钟让 AI 写对十行逻辑，但它连续两次没理解；你自己一分钟能写完。
q: 最务实的选择是什么？
options: 继续和 AI 纠缠直到成功
换一个无关模型继续试
停止提示，自己写这十行
放弃这个功能
options_en: Keep fighting with the AI until it finally succeeds.
Switch to an unrelated model and keep trying.
Stop prompting and write the ten lines yourself.
Give up on the feature entirely.
why: 工具的目的不是证明能用 AI，而是更快正确推进；能手写更快时就该手写。
why_en: If writing it yourself is faster than fighting the AI, do that and keep moving.
whenOtherWins: 如果实现很长但只是约束表达不清，先做一次更具体的重提示仍可能划算。
tradeoff: 继续纠缠的时间成本 vs 自己写的确定性 —— 已知一分钟能搞定时，纠缠 AI 的边际时间不再划算。
optionMeanings: 在已经两次失败后仍选择继续同一条路径的做法。
把问题归咎于模型本身、临时更换模型继续试的做法。
承认这条路径性价比已经不划算，切到自己写的做法。
因为工具没配合就放弃整个功能的极端做法。
optionScenarioImpacts: 已经花两分钟还没成功，继续纠缠边际收益递减。
换模型的上下文切换成本可能比自己写还高。
多花一分钟直接拿到正确实现，总时间最短。
功能本身并不难，放弃是不必要的损失。
optionDirectness: 时机错：沉没成本继续投入，收益不确定。
方向错：问题未必出在模型本身。
命中评分点：手写更快时就该手写，工具是手段不是目的。
范围错：不是工具问题就该放弃功能。
optionMeanings_en: Continuing the same path even after two failed attempts.
Blaming the model itself and swapping to a different one.
Accepting the path no longer pays off and switching to writing it yourself.
Giving up on the whole feature just because the tool didn’t cooperate.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Two minutes are already spent with no success; further fighting has diminishing returns.
The context-switch cost of a new model may exceed just writing it yourself.
One more minute gets a correct implementation — the shortest total time.
The feature itself isn’t hard; giving up is an unnecessary loss.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong timing: chasing sunk cost with uncertain payoff.
Wrong direction: the problem isn’t necessarily the model itself.
Hits the mark: write it yourself when that’s faster — the tool is a means, not the goal.
Wrong scope: a tool problem doesn’t justify abandoning the feature.

q: 补全一条经验规则：
text: 如果 AI 第一次没写对，可以{{重提示一次}}；如果仍没对，通常应该{{自己写}}或缩小任务，而不是继续耗时。
why: 单个生成上纠缠超过几分钟，往往比直接实现或拆小问题更不划算；这是给定的经验阈值，不是靠公式推导出来的。
why_en: A practical rule of thumb is one reprompt, then write it yourself or break the task down.

q: 面试中 AI 输出不佳时，为什么切换模型通常不是首选？
options: 切换模型一定被禁止
切换模型会删除代码库
所有模型输出完全一样
更具体地重提示或自己写，通常比切换上下文更快
options_en: Switching models is always forbidden.
Switching models deletes the codebase.
All models produce exactly the same output.
Reprompting more specifically or writing it yourself is usually faster than switching context.
why: 模型切换有上下文和时间成本，问题常常来自提示不清或任务太大，而不是模型名称。
why_en: Reprompting more specifically or writing it yourself is usually faster than switching models mid-interview.
tradeoff: 切换模型的上下文成本 vs 重提示/自己写的确定性 —— 换模型要重建上下文，通常比说清楚约束更慢。
optionMeanings: 把切换模型误解成规则明令禁止的说法。
把切换模型和破坏代码库画等号的说法。
把模型间差异抹平成完全等价的说法。
点出切换模型的隐藏成本是上下文重建时间。
optionScenarioImpacts: 不成立，切换模型通常不是被禁止，只是不划算。
不成立，切换模型不会对代码库产生影响。
不成立，不同模型输出质量确实有差异。
重提示或自己写不需要重建上下文，通常更省时间。
optionDirectness: 机制错：不是规则禁止，是时间成本问题。
机制错：切换模型不涉及删除代码。
事实错：模型间输出并非完全一样。
命中评分点：上下文重建成本通常高于重提示成本。
optionMeanings_en: The misconception that switching models is banned by rule.
The misconception that switching models damages the codebase.
The misconception that different models are fully interchangeable.
Naming the hidden cost of switching as context-rebuild time.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Not true — switching isn’t forbidden, it’s just usually a bad trade.
Not true — switching models has no effect on the codebase.
Not true — output quality does differ across models.
Reprompting or writing it yourself skips context rebuilding, usually saving time.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong mechanism: it’s a time-cost issue, not a rule ban.
Wrong mechanism: switching does not involve deleting code.
Wrong fact: model output is not identical across models.
Hits the mark: context-rebuild cost usually exceeds reprompt cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: AI 助手在当前会话里已经了解的代码、约束和历史信息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Context is everything the AI assistant already knows in the current session — the code, constraints, and history so far.

q: 结构化面试里的 AI 为什么可能感觉比你平时用的工具弱？
options: 因为公司平台一定是故意把 AI 削弱来为难候选人
因为面试用的浏览器本身技术上无法运行任何模型
因为面试题目文本根本传不进 AI 的输入窗口
因为平台 AI 可能缺少日常工具里的系统提示、代码上下文和工作流集成
options_en: Because the company platform must be deliberately weakening the AI to make it hard for candidates.
Because the interview browser is technically incapable of running any model.
Because the interview problem text technically can’t reach the AI’s input window.
Because the platform AI may lack the system prompt, code context, and workflow integration your daily tools have.
why: 不管是否故意限制，实际效果是工具能力更弱，你需要降低期待并更多依赖自己的理解。
why_en: Interview AI may feel weaker because it lacks the system prompt, context, and workflow integration of your daily tools.
optionMeanings: 把体感变弱直接归因于故意削弱的确定性说法。
把体感变弱误解成浏览器技术限制。
把体感变弱误解成完全读不到题目。
把体感变弱归因于缺少系统提示和上下文集成。
optionScenarioImpacts: 文章态度是不确定是否故意，这个说法过于绝对。
不成立，浏览器本身能承载模型调用。
不成立，AI 通常能读到题目文本。
不管是否故意，实际效果就是能力更弱，需要调低预期。
optionDirectness: 标准错：不确定是否故意，不能断言一定。
机制错：浏览器不是能力弱的原因。
事实错：读取题目不是问题所在。
命中评分点：缺系统提示/上下文/工作流集成才是主因。
optionMeanings_en: The certain claim that it is always deliberately weakened.
The misconception that a browser limitation causes it.
The misconception that it cannot read the problem at all.
Attributing the weaker feel to missing system prompt and context integration.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Whether it’s deliberate is uncertain, so this claim overreaches.
Not true — a browser can carry model calls fine.
Not true — the AI can usually read the problem text.
Deliberate or not, the practical effect is weaker capability, so lower your expectations.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong standard: intent is uncertain, so "always" overstates it.
Wrong mechanism: the browser is not the cause of weaker capability.
Wrong fact: reading the problem is not the issue.
Hits the mark: missing system prompt/context/workflow integration is the real driver.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在用户看不到的地方预先设定 AI 行为和上下文的隐藏指令。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A system prompt is the hidden instruction that pre-configures an AI assistant’s behavior and context before the user’s own messages.

q: 遇到能力受限的面试 AI 时，适合让它做哪些事？（多选）
options: 生成样板代码
解释陌生语法
搭建基础结构
替你做所有架构判断
options_en: Generate boilerplate code.
Explain unfamiliar syntax.
Scaffold basic structure.
Make every architecture decision for you.
why: 弱 AI 仍能加速基础工作，但难点思考和架构取舍必须由你兜住。
why_en: A limited AI can still help with boilerplate, syntax explanations, and scaffolding while you own the hard reasoning.
optionMeanings: 重复、模式固定的代码交给它生成。
让它解释不熟悉的语言特性或库用法。
让它先搭出模块骨架，细节你再填充。
把本该由你做的架构取舍也交出去。
optionScenarioImpacts: 省下打字体量，你仍要核对是否贴合项目模式。
补齐知识空白，不涉及架构判断风险。
加速起步，但骨架是否合理仍要你把关。
面试官看不到你的判断，能力受限时风险更高。
optionDirectness: 命中：体量型工作，受限 AI 仍能胜任。
命中：知识解释型工作，不依赖强上下文。
命中：起步骨架，细节仍需你把关。
方向反：架构判断正是你该兜住的部分，不能外包。
optionMeanings_en: Handing repetitive, pattern-fixed code to the AI to generate.
Asking it to explain unfamiliar language features or library usage.
Letting it scaffold a module first, with you filling in the details.
Handing over the architecture decisions that should be yours.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It saves typing volume; you still verify it fits the project pattern.
It fills a knowledge gap without touching architecture risk.
It speeds up the start, but you still judge whether the scaffold is sound.
The interviewer sees no judgment from you, riskier when the AI is limited.
optionDirectness_en: Hits the mark: high-volume work a limited AI can still handle.
Hits the mark: knowledge-explanation work doesn’t need deep context.
Hits the mark: starter scaffolding, details still need your review.
Reversed direction: architecture judgment is exactly what you must own.

q: 只用最强日常 AI 工具练习，面试时有什么风险？
options: 风险其实很小，因为不管哪个模型能力都完全一样
你会因为换了个工具就完全不会写提示了
所有结构化面试平台都会自动帮你同步日常工具的个人设置
你可能没有形成在受限 AI 只能完成一部分时继续推进的工作流
options_en: The risk is actually small because every model has exactly the same capability.
You would completely forget how to write a prompt just from switching tools.
Every structured interview platform automatically syncs your daily-tool personal settings.
You may never build a workflow for making progress when a limited AI can only get you part of the way.
why: 真实面试工具可能更慢、更弱或上下文更少，没练过受限环境会让你措手不及。
why_en: Practicing only with top-tier daily tools can leave you unprepared when interview AI is slower or less capable.
optionMeanings: 把不同工具/模型的差异抹平成没有风险的说法。
把风险夸大成提示能力完全丧失的极端说法。
把设置同步能力当成结构化平台特性的误解。
指出真正的风险是缺少应对受限工具的工作流。
optionScenarioImpacts: 不成立，面试 AI 和日常工具能力差距是真实风险。
不成立，提示能力不会因为换工具就消失。
不成立，结构化平台通常不带你的个人配置。
真实面试工具更弱时，你会缺少可用的应对套路。
optionDirectness: 标准错：低估了工具能力差距带来的风险。
程度错：夸大到完全丧失，不符合实际。
机制错：平台不会同步个人设置。
命中评分点：缺的是受限环境下的工作流，不是能力本身。
optionMeanings_en: The claim that model differences flatten the risk to zero.
The extreme claim of totally losing prompting ability.
The misconception that structured platforms sync personal settings.
Naming the real risk as lacking a workflow for constrained tools.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Not true — the capability gap between interview and daily AI is a real risk.
Not true — prompting ability doesn’t vanish from switching tools.
Not true — structured platforms don’t carry your personal config.
When the real interview tool is weaker, you lack a fallback workflow.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong standard: underestimates the real capability gap.
Wrong degree: overstates it as total loss, unrealistic.
Wrong mechanism: platforms don’t sync personal settings.
Hits the mark: the missing piece is a workflow for constrained tools, not raw skill.

q: 把 AI 输出不佳时的恢复链排好：
steps: 如果仍失败且手写更快，就自己实现
识别具体偏差：算法、接口、风格或正确性
用更具体的上下文和约束重提示一次
运行或审阅确认修正是否有效
why: 恢复坏输出要先定位偏差，再重定向，再验证；持续失败时果断脱离 AI。
why_en: Recover from bad output by identifying the mismatch, reprompting with constraints, verifying, then writing it yourself if needed.
tradeoff: 重提示一次 vs 直接接管 —— 先花一次精确重提示的成本，换取避免过早放弃 AI 的效率损失；反复失败就该换成本更低的自己写。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Bad[Bad output] --> Diagnose[Name issue]
  Diagnose --> Reprompt[One focused reprompt]
  Reprompt --> Review[Review result]
  Review --> Decide{Better?}
  Decide -->|no| Manual[Take over]

scenario: AI 建议用一个新架构，但你还无法解释它为什么比原计划更适合当前题目。
q: 你应该怎么做？
options: 马上采纳，因为 AI 可能更聪明
让 AI 自己决定所有后续步骤
删除原计划
先不采纳，除非你能说明它更适合的原因
options_en: Adopt it immediately because the AI might be smarter.
Let the AI decide every subsequent step on its own.
Delete the original plan outright.
Hold off unless you can explain why it actually fits better.
why: 改变方案的理由必须来自你对题目和约束的判断，而不是 AI 提出了一个看起来高级的替代品。
why_en: You should only adopt an AI-suggested approach if you can explain why it better fits the problem.
whenOtherWins: 如果 AI 指出了你确实漏掉的约束，并且新方案能清楚解决它，那就是合理的 pivot。
tradeoff: 方案切换的潜在收益 vs 你能否为它辩护 —— 换方案的理由必须来自你的判断，不是 AI 看起来更高级。
optionMeanings: 只因为建议来自 AI 就直接采纳的做法。
把后续所有决策权也交给 AI 的做法。
还没确认新方案更优就先销毁旧方案的做法。
把采纳的门槛设为你能说清楚原因的做法。
optionScenarioImpacts: 如果被追问为什么换方案，你答不上来。
面试官从此看不到任何你自己的判断。
一旦新架构站不住，你已经没有退路。
换与不换都有你自己的理由，能在追问下站住。
optionDirectness: 标准错：采纳理由来自 AI 身份，不是论证。
方向错：决策权本该在你，不能整体外包。
时机错：先销毁退路，后确认方案，顺序反了。
命中评分点：能不能辩护，是采纳与否的判据。
optionMeanings_en: Adopting a suggestion just because it came from the AI.
Handing all subsequent decisions to the AI.
Destroying the old plan before confirming the new one is better.
Setting the adoption bar at being able to explain why yourself.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: If asked why you switched, you have no answer.
The interviewer sees none of your own judgment from this point on.
Once the new architecture doesn’t hold up, you have no way back.
Either way you have your own reason, defensible under follow-up questions.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong standard: the reason comes from the AI’s identity, not an argument.
Wrong direction: decision ownership should stay with you, not be outsourced.
Wrong timing: burns the fallback before confirming the new plan, order reversed.
Hits the mark: defensibility is the actual bar for adoption.

q: “不要在破损代码上继续叠新功能”背后的原因是什么？
options: 新功能一定写不出来
AI 无法读取编译错误
面试官不允许运行测试
你会失去错误来源，后续调试成本快速放大
options_en: New features simply cannot be written at all.
The AI is unable to read compiler errors.
The interviewer forbids running tests.
You lose track of the error’s source, and later debugging cost balloons.
why: 代码一旦处于未知坏状态，新错误和旧错误混在一起，AI 也更容易修错方向。
why_en: Layering features on broken code hides the source of errors and makes later debugging much more expensive.
optionMeanings: 把破损代码上继续开发说成完全不可能的极端说法。
把限制归因到 AI 的读取能力，与实际原因无关。
把限制归因到面试官规则，与实际原因无关。
指出破损状态下新旧错误混在一起，定位成本上升。
optionScenarioImpacts: 不成立，代码依然能继续写，只是错误会叠加。
